_comment: One unified list for every local model source. Copy to models.json and edit. Only 'name' plus either 'path' or 'url' is required per entry — ports are allocated automatically and the rest comes from 'defaults'.
_softContextLimit_comment: softContextLimit is a FAKE ceiling below a model's real --ctx-size. A request above it is rejected with llama.cpp's own exceed_context_size_error, which DSH classifies as CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED and answers by compacting. The gap between it and the real window is the redundancy that lets the summarization request run. 0 disables it. It must stay ABOVE DSH's own proactive-compaction trigger, or it would also block the summarization replay.
_ports_comment: Public ports are handed out as publicBase + index, internal ports as internalBase + index. Set publicPort / internalPort on an entry to override.
_defaults_comment: Applied to every managed model that does not override the field. softContextRatio derives softContextLimit from ctxSize (0.75 x 32768 = 24576).
_llamaServer_comment: How to launch llama-server. 'common' is accepted as an alias for backwards compatibility. Keep --host out of the per-model args since the supervisor supplies --port itself.

models._comment: Managed: the supervisor spawns llama-server for this file, cold-starts it on the first request and releases it when idle. Gets public port 8080 -> internal 9080.
models.name: qwen-2bit

models._comment: Managed, second slot (public 8081 -> internal 9081), with per-model overrides.
models.name: qwen-4bit

models._comment: External: an already-running OpenAI-compatible server. Forwarded to on public port 8082; never started or stopped by the supervisor (no idle release for these).
models.name: ollama
